notes: Replication reference title matches the OSF project n35c2. Supplied r58ch identifies its Kausel2015Stage2Report.docx file, rather than a project node. Stage 2 values retained separately from Stage 1; no sample size inferred from degrees of freedom. Original acquisition: DOI landing route failed; OpenAlex verified title and identified the Universidad de Chile repository as the sole OA location; repository served an access challenge, not a PDF. ResearchGate returned 403 directly and its accessible web page explicitly reported no full text. No blocked route was retried. Original values remain unverified. Replication report explicitly labels 1062 as the Stage 2 analytic sample after exclusions; this is retained as printed, without reconciling it to regression degrees of freedom. Stage 1 statistics are a separate sample and are not combined with Stage 2.
